fields.description: Master kill switch for eTIMS integration. When unchecked, no documents should be auto-submitted to KRA eTIMS (enforced by hook/queue logic elsewhere, not by this field alone).
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: KRA eTIMS device type: OSCU (Online Sales Control Unit) or VSCU (Virtual Sales Control Unit). Confirm which mode applies to this taxpayer with the etims-integration-specialist.
fields.label: Device Mode

fields.description: KRA-issued taxpayer PIN (eTIMS `tin`).
fields.label: KRA PIN (TIN)

fields.description: SDC ID / CU ID for this device (eTIMS `sdcId`). May be entered as plaintext or as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob — see Key Input Format below.
fields.label: SDC ID (CU ID)

fields.description: KRA-assigned branch/office identifier for this business location (eTIMS `bhfId`).
fields.label: Branch ID (bhfId)

fields.description: Serial number of the registered OSCU/VSCU control unit device (eTIMS `dvcSrlNo`). May be entered as plaintext or as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob — see Key Input Format below.
fields.label: Device Serial Number (dvcSrlNo)

fields.description: MRC number for this device (eTIMS `mrcNo`). May be entered as plaintext or as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob — see Key Input Format below.
fields.label: MRC No

fields.description: Base URL for the KRA eTIMS sandbox/test API environment. Only used while Environment is set to Sandbox.
fields.label: Sandbox Base URL

fields.description: Base URL for the live KRA eTIMS production API environment. Only used while Environment is set to Production.
fields.label: Production Base URL

fields.description: OAuth/API secret used to authenticate with KRA eTIMS. Stored encrypted via Frappe's Password fieldtype.
fields.label: API Secret

fields.description: PIN for the control unit, stored encrypted. Confirm with the etims-integration-specialist whether/how KRA requires this for OSCU/VSCU signing.
fields.label: Control Unit PIN

fields.description: Cached bearer/auth token returned by the KRA eTIMS auth endpoint, stored encrypted so requests can reuse it instead of re-authenticating every call.
fields.label: Cached Auth Token

fields.description: Expiry timestamp of the cached auth token. Used to decide whether to refresh the token before the next API call.
fields.label: Token Expires At

fields.description: Communication key (eTIMS `cmcKey`) used to secure device communication with KRA eTIMS. Stored encrypted. May be entered as plaintext or as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob — see Key Input Format below.
fields.label: CMC Key

fields.description: Interchange key (eTIMS `intrlKey`). Stored encrypted. May be entered as plaintext or as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob — see Key Input Format below.
fields.label: Interchange Key

fields.description: Signing key (eTIMS `signKey`) used to sign invoice payloads. Stored encrypted. May be entered as plaintext or as an AES/Base64-encrypted blob — see Key Input Format below.
fields.label: Sign Key

fields.description: Whether SDC ID, Device Serial Number, MRC No, CMC Key, Interchange Key, and Sign Key above were just entered as plaintext or as AES/Base64-encrypted blobs. On save, Encrypted values are decrypted using the AES Key below and stored as plaintext; this field then resets to Decrypted.
fields.label: Key Input Format

fields.description: AES-128 key (hex) used to decrypt/encrypt the values above (scheme: AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding, Base64). Required only when Key Input Format is Encrypted. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: AES Key

fields.description: Reference only — JCEKS keystore alias the AES key was sourced from. Not used directly by this app's AES/ECB decrypt routine.
fields.label: Keystore Alias

fields.description: Reference only — JCEKS keystore/key password, if the keystore file itself is ever loaded directly rather than via the raw AES Key above. Stored encrypted.
fields.label: Keystore Password

fields.description: When enabled (and Enabled is checked), submitted Sales Invoices are automatically queued for submission to KRA eTIMS.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Sales Invoices

fields.description: When enabled (and Enabled is checked), new/updated Items are automatically queued for registration with KRA eTIMS.
fields.label: Auto-Submit Items
